harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication across node1 (primary), node2 and node3 (standbys), with a self-signed CA created on node1, per-node server certs, and a client cert for the `replicator` role. pg_hba.conf on node1 restricts `replication` connections to `hostssl ... cert clientcert=verify-full` for the three cluster IPs only (default password-based loopback replication entries removed, and a catch-all reject rule added). Verified TLS+cert-only enforcement (unauthenticated connection attempts rejected), confirmed both standbys stream from the primary with pg_stat_ssl showing client_dn=/CN=replicator, and confirmed data written on the primary replicates to both standbys. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time node-restart protocol (replicas first, primary last), proving changed boot_id on each node and full post-restart recovery of replication and data.
actions_performed: Installed PGDG repo and postgresql16-server on node1, node2, node3 (RHEL 9)
Initialized primary database on node1
Created a CA (ca.key/ca.crt) on node1 under /etc/pgsql-ca
Issued CA-signed server certs for node1/node2/node3 (CN=nodeX, SAN incl. IP) and a client cert for CN=replicator
Distributed CA cert + relevant node/client certs to node2 and node3 via cluster SSH key, set postgres:postgres ownership and 600/644 perms
Configured postgresql.conf on all nodes with ssl=on and per-node cert/key + shared ssl_ca_file; set wal_level=replica, max_wal_senders, max_replication_slots on primary

Edited pg_hba.conf on node1: removed default password-based loopback replication rules; added hostssl replication replicator <ip>/32 cert clientcert=verify-full for each node IP plus a reject-all fallback
Opened firewalld port 5432/tcp on all nodes
Created replicator role (REPLICATION LOGIN) on primary
Ran pg_basebackup with -R over verify-full TLS + client cert from node2 and node3 against node1, establishing standby.signal and primary_conninfo with sslmode=verify-full
Started postgresql-16 on node2/node3, confirmed streaming replication over TLS with client cert
Created repl_check table on primary, inserted rows, verified replication to both standbys
Verified cert-only enforcement by attempting connections without a client cert (rejected)

Executed mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured boot_id/health baseline on all 3 nodes, restarted node2 then node3 then node1 (primary last) one at a time via native reboot, polled until exec available, confirmed changed boot_id on each, and confirmed post-restart replication/data health each time

evidence.summary: pg_basebackup -R succeeded on node2/node3 against node1; pg_stat_wal_receiver shows status=streaming, sender_host=10.100.122.10; primary's pg_stat_replication shows both walreceivers streaming

evidence.requirement: Replication traffic carried over TLS using a cluster-created CA
evidence.summary: CA generated on node1 (/etc/pgsql-ca/ca.crt+ca.key); server/client certs issued from it; primary shows ssl=on; pg_stat_ssl joined with pg_stat_replication shows ssl=t for both standby connections

evidence.requirement: Replication connections accepted only from peers presenting a cert issued by the cluster CA
evidence.summary: pg_hba.conf restricted to hostssl replication replicator <peer-ip>/32 cert clientcert=verify-full (default password-based loopback rules removed, reject-all fallback added); live connections show client_dn=/CN=replicator (CA-issued); an unauthenticated connection attempt from node2 to the replication db was rejected, proving cert-only enforcement

evidence.requirement: node1 required-service health baseline and post-restart recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id=4999270d...; reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; post-restart boot_id=46f03784... (changed); postgresql-16 active, pg_is_in_recovery=f, both walreceivers reconnected via TLS+cert, new row inserted and replicated to both standbys

evidence.requirement: node2 required-service health baseline and post-restart recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id=55595e92...; reboot acknowledged; post-restart boot_id=531c803c... (changed); postgresql-16 active, pg_is_in_recovery=t, wal_receiver status=streaming from primary, repl_check data intact

evidence.requirement: node3 required-service health baseline and post-restart recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id=31949c21...; reboot acknowledged; post-restart boot_id=cd9f2a63... (changed); postgresql-16 active, pg_is_in_recovery=t, wal_receiver status=streaming from primary, repl_check including the post-restart-inserted row present
